name: No Copilot orchestrator: you own grounding
symptom: HLE Grid Advisor cannot answer the Eastern Ontario staging area question from the Storm Restoration Playbook in the same library; it says the answer is not in its sources
cause: A custom engine agent brings its own orchestration, model and data; it does not inherit Copilot retrieval over SharePoint
fix: Add documents to the agent's own retrieval corpus, or query SharePoint through Graph with the user's token (SSO); otherwise answer not in my sources

name: Responsible AI controls are yours
symptom: With RAI_FILTERS=off, injection, unsafe-work and customer-data prompts reach the model; answers lose citation checks and redaction and may leak the system prompt canary (observe)
cause: The builder owns input and output filtering, citations and refusals for a custom engine agent
fix: Keep RAI_FILTERS=on; enable deployment content filters; extend tests; review with the organization's responsible AI process

name: License requirement conflict for custom engine agents
symptom: Observe and record whether Tom Whitfield (no Copilot license) can use HLE Grid Advisor in Teams and in Copilot Chat
cause: Learn sources conflict: LIC-13 says no Copilot license needed; LIC-14 says licensed users or metered tenants only
fix: Test in your tenant and record the date; confirm billing before promising unlicensed access

name: SSO configuration pitfalls
symptom: Observe and record: sign-in or consent prompt instead of silent SSO, sign-in loop, or agent error after changing the OAuth connection name, Application ID URI or pre-authorized clients
cause: SSO needs matching identifiers across the Entra app, the Azure Bot OAuth connection and the app manifest
fix: Undo the change or re-run Agents Toolkit Provision; use the toolkit path for SSO

name: Tool endpoint still points at localhost after deployment
symptom: Deployed agent reports live outage data unavailable (API_UNREACHABLE) and lists no outages
cause: HLE_API_BASE_URL left at http://localhost:7071/api; in App Service localhost is the app itself
fix: Set HLE_API_BASE_URL to the Function App or dev tunnel URL with /api and restart

name: Preview and unverified status in the Copilot Studio Foundry extension
symptom: Observe and record which Foundry options and Preview labels appear for prompt models, the agent primary model and connected Foundry agents
cause: Foundry for prompts is GA (SNIP); Foundry as primary model has no confirmed status; connecting Foundry agents is PREVIEW
fix: Use only GA features in production; record labels and dates; keep preview features out of HLE-Prod
